Hook runs after deletion so has() is false. SessionStore uses onEvict to save only capacity evictions to backing store, get() rehydrates from backing (removing there and re-inserting into LRU), and destroy() deletes from LRU (reason delete, so not saved) and removes from backing, satisfying logout semantics.
